To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) AI models in Education should be transparent to the user, (ii) the AI models should be interpretable by humans, and (iii) the AI models need to be explainable for the users.

the following conditions need to be satisfied in order to make the use of AI in Education beneficial: the AI models must be interpretable and explain the underlying reasoning, the learners' and tutors' models of the AI system must be aligned and shared, and the AI system must provide a safe environment for the learner to learn and make mistakes.

the following three conditions must be met in order to make an AI system interpretable for the benefit of learners: (1) the AI must be transparent to the learners; (2) the learners must be able to interact with the AI in a way that enables the learners to understand what is happening inside the AI; and (3) the learners must have the necessary background knowledge to understand what is going on.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to design, develop and deploy AI systems that are explainable, trustworthy and fair.
the development of AI systems in the context of human learning, and the development of AI that is interpretable and explain able for the purpose of enhancing learning and teaching.
the following question: How can AI in Education support learning and teaching, and what are the key challenges for interpretable AI in Education?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the AI in education community has been working for over thirty years on the problem of interpretable AI in the form of Open Learner Models, which are knowledge based systems that provide a model of learners' cognition that is open to human understanding.
OLM research has demonstrated that AI in Education is a complex and difficult problem, which can be solved with AI, but only if it is interpretable.
interpretable AI is a necessary condition for the successful deployment of AI in education, but it is not sufficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, to be interpretable and explain the AI models to humans, the machine learning algorithms need to be transparent and open, the AI representations need to be grounded in human cognition, the AI models need to be open and the AI models need be able to be used for the benefit of the learner.
OLMs are a useful framework for the design of interpretable AI in Education.
the AI models used in education must be designed with interpretability and explainability in mind.
The main takeaway from our work is that
interpretability of AI models is a necessary condition for AI in Education.
interpretability is not a property of AI systems, but a property of the human-technology interaction.

the interpretability of AI systems in education is not a technical problem, but a socio-technical one that involves the entire ecosystem of the AI system, including the users, the developers and the designers of such systems.
